name: PayPal App Switch Demo Server
postStartCommand:
cd demo-server && echo "PAYPAL_CLIENT_ID=$PAYPAL_CLIENT_ID
PAYPAL_CLIENT_SECRET=$PAYPAL_CLIENT_SECRET
PAYPAL_API_BASE=https://api-m.sandbox.paypal.com
RETURN_DOMAIN=https://example.com
PORT=3000" > .env && npm start

PAYPAL_CLIENT_ID.description: PayPal sandbox Client ID. Get one at https://developer.paypal.com/dashboard/applications/sandbox

PAYPAL_CLIENT_SECRET.description: PayPal sandbox Client Secret from the same dashboard page.
